agents.name: UI Exception Handler
agents.description: Module responsible for managing UI-related errors. This module has access to the current UI state via screenshots and is provided with visual information about the moment where execution failed. It specializes in identifying and resolving issues related to user interface interactions, element detection, and visual validation failures.
